question_text: 1. An international application is published, together with the search report drawn up  by the CNIPA, 18 months + 1 day after the filing date (no priority claimed). The  application has no more than 35 pages and 15 claims.   Which statement reflects all actions the CN applicant needs to take for entry into the  EP phase 25 months after the filing date? A request for early processing has been filed.

answer_choices.a: Complete and file Form 1200 and pay the filing fee and the search fee
answer_choices.b: Complete and file Form 1200 and pay the filing fee, the search fee and the  renewal fee for the third year
answer_choices.c: Complete and file Form 1200, pay the filing fee and the search fee and appoint  a representative

legal_basis.text:
Rule 159(1) EPC The examination fee and designation fee must also be paid (six months after 
publication of search report; payment cannot be postponed to 31 months if there is a 
wish to enter into the European phase at 25 months).

question_text: 2. A European patent application was filed on 6 February 2023. The search, filing and  designation fees were paid within a month of the date of filing.    What is the latest point in time for withdrawing the application, if the applicant wishes  to obtain a refund of the designation fee?

answer_choices.a: Six months after the date of mention of the publication of the European search  report
answer_choices.b: Date of mention of the publication of the European search report
answer_choices.c: The designation fee was validly paid and can no longer be refunded
answer_choices.d: Date of the start of substantive examination

legal_basis.text:
Guidelines for Examination in the EPO, A-X, 5.2.2 
“The designation fee falls due upon publication of the mention of the European 
search report. It may be paid within six months of the mentioned date of publication 
(Rules 39(1), 17(3) and 36(4)). Where paid before the due date, e.g. upon filing of the 
application, the designation fee will however be retained by the EPO. These 
payments will only be considered valid as from the due date, provided that the 
amount paid corresponds to the amount payable on the due date (…)”

question_text: 3. On 10 October 2024, an applicant files a request for entry into the European phase,  together with a debit order, according to which the filing fee, the designation fee, the  examination fee and the renewal fee for the third year are to be debited from the  applicant’s deposit account. It is specified that the debit order is to be executed on  18 October 2024. On the evening of 10 October 2024, the applicant notices that the  renewal fee is not yet due and should not be debited from the deposit account.   What is the latest point in time for revoking the order to debit the renewal fee in Central  Fee Payment (CFP)?

answer_choices.d: A debit order cannot be revoked in part

legal_basis.text:
OJ EPO 2024, Supplementary Publication 2,  Arrangements for deposit accounts 
(ADA), 13.2 
“13.2: A debit order with a deferred payment date (…) may be revoked in whole or in 
part in Central Fee Payment until one day before the date specified as the execution 
date at the latest.”

question_text: 4. The applicant received a communication pursuant to Article 90(3) EPC and Rule 60  EPC, requesting them to file a designation of inventor but missed the time limit for filing  a response. After expiry of the time limit, the Receiving Section issued a decision to  refuse the European patent application, dated 10 October 2024.   What can the applicant do to remedy the situation?

answer_choices.a: File a notice of appeal against the decision within four months of notification of  the decision
answer_choices.b: File a request for further processing within two months of notification of the  decision
answer_choices.c: File, within two months of notification of the decision, a request for  re-establishment of rights in respect of the time limit for filing the designation of inventor
answer_choices.d: A, B and C are correct

legal_basis.text:
Articles 106 and 108 EPC; Article 121(1) EPC; Guidelines for Examination in the 
EPO, E-VIII, 2 
A notice of appeal could also be filed within two months of notification of the decision; 
re-establishment of rights is excluded because further processing is available.

question_text: 5. Which of the following statements about filing third-party observations is correct?

answer_choices.a: The person that filed third-party observations will be a party to the proceedings  before the EPO, and the applicant is obliged to respond to third-party observations
answer_choices.b: Third-party observations must be filed in writing and may not be filed  anonymously
answer_choices.c: Third-party observations are considered by the examining division only if they  include a statement of the grounds on which they are based, and an official fee is paid
answer_choices.d: Third-party observations can be filed after the publication of a European patent  application and must be filed in an official language of the EPO

legal_basis.text: Article 115 EPC, Rule 114 EPC; Guidelines for Examination in the EPO, E-VI.3

A. Incorrect: a third party filing observations concerning the patentability of an 
application or patent is not a party to the proceedings; the applicant may 
respond to third-party observations but is not obliged to do so 
B. Incorrect: third-party observations may be filed anonymously 
C. Incorrect: there is no official fee when filing third-party observations 
D. Correct

question_text: 6. You filed an international patent application on 6 June 2024, claiming the priority of  a European patent application filed on 7 July 2023. You received a communication  dated 25 September 2024 from the EPO acting as International Searching Authority  (ISA), stating that the requirement of unity of invention has not been complied with.  The ISA identifies three inventions. You are invited to pay two additional search fees.   Which of the following statements is correct?

answer_choices.a: You must pay two additional search fees by 25 October 2024
answer_choices.b: You do not need to file a response to the provisional opinion accompanying the  partial search results
answer_choices.c: If you pay two additional search fees under protest, you must pay two protest  fees within the time limit
answer_choices.d: If you do not pay any additional search fees within the time limit, the international  patent application will be deemed to be withdrawn

legal_basis.text: Rule 40 PCT

A. Incorrect: may be paid but not must be paid 
B. Correct 
C. Incorrect: only one protest fee is due (Rule 40.2(e) PCT) 
D. Incorrect: if the applicant does not pay any additional search fees, the 
information appearing in the invitation to pay additional fees will be considered 
to be the result of the international search and will be included as such in the 
international search report

question_text: 7. An international patent application filed with the EPO as receiving Office on  10 September 2024, claims the priority of a Luxembourg patent application filed on  11 October 2023. No certified copy of the Luxembourg patent application was filed at  the time of filing of the international patent application.    Which of the following actions can be taken to file a certified copy of the Luxembourg  patent application for this international patent application?

answer_choices.a: Request the Luxembourg Intellectual Property Office to prepare and send a  certified copy of the Luxembourg patent application to the EPO
answer_choices.b: Submit a valid DAS code (Digital Access Service) to the International Bureau to  enable it to obtain a certified copy of the Luxembourg patent application
answer_choices.c: File an electronic certified copy of the Luxembourg patent application with the  EPO
answer_choices.d: File a certified copy of the Luxembourg patent application with the International  Bureau

legal_basis.text:
PCT Applicant's Guide 5.070.; Guidelines for Examination in the EPO A-III, 6.7; 
PCT Applicant’s Guide LU-Luxembourg

A. Only available if the priority application and the PCT application are filed with 
the same patent office  
B. Incorrect: the LPTO does not use the DAS access code  
C. Incorrect: the LPTO does not issue electronic priority documents 
D. Correct

question_text: 8. Firm A owns a European patent, EP. Firm B filed an opposition against EP,  requesting its revocation. Firm B argued that the subject-matter of the granted claims  was not new in view of document D1.  During the opposition proceedings, firm C filed observations under Art. 115 EPC,  arguing that the subject-matter of the granted claims was not new in view of document  D2.  Firm A requested maintenance of the patent as granted, or maintenance in amended  form, according to auxiliary request 1.  Which of the following statements is correct?

answer_choices.a: At the end of the opposition proceedings, the opposition division decided to  revoke the patent. Firm B is entitled to file an appeal against the opposition division's  decision.
answer_choices.b: At the end of the opposition proceedings, the opposition division decided to  maintain the patent in amended form according to firm A's auxiliary request 1. Firm A  and firm B are entitled to file an appeal against the opposition division's decision.
answer_choices.c: At the end of the opposition proceedings, the opposition division decided to  maintain the patent as granted. Firm C is entitled to file an appeal against the  opposition division's decision.
answer_choices.d: During the opposition proceedings, firm B withdrew its opposition. At the end of  the opposition proceedings, the opposition division decided to maintain the patent as  granted. Firm B is entitled to file an appeal against the opposition division's decision.

legal_basis.text: Article 107 EPC

A. Incorrect: B is not adversely affected 
B. Correct: both parties A and B are adversely affected 
C. Incorrect: third parties are not parties to the proceedings 
D. Incorrect: withdrew its opposition; no longer a party to the proceedings

question_text: 9. European patent application EP-X was filed on 1 October 2020, claiming the priority  of a Belgian application filed on 16 October 2019. The mention of the grant of European  patent EP-X was published on 2 October 2024. The proprietor filed a request for unitary  effect and was informed by communication dated 10 October 2024, that unitary effect  had been registered for EP-X-C0 on the same date.    Which of the following statements is correct?

answer_choices.a: A renewal fee still has to be paid by 31 October 2024 in respect of the 5th year  for EP-X
answer_choices.b: A renewal fee is due on 31 October 2024 in respect of the 5th year for EP-X-C0
answer_choices.c: A renewal fee is due on 31 October 2024 in respect of the 6th year for EP-X-C0
answer_choices.d: No renewal fee has to be paid on 31 October 2024

legal_basis.text: Guidelines for Examination in the EPO, A-X, 5.2.4

The renewal fee that would have been due on 31 October had to be paid for the 
decision to grant to be issued (this is one of the warnings in the communication under 
Rule 71(3) EPC).

question_text: 10. A communication under Article 94(3) EPC, setting a four-month time limit for reply  is dated 12 September 2024. The applicant receives the letter on 21 September 2024,  as evidenced by the postal receipt signed by him.     What is the last day for replying to the communication?

legal_basis.text: Rule 126(2) EPC

The document was delivered to the addressee nine days after the date it bears, so 
the period expires later by the number of days by which the seven days were 
exceeded, i.e. 12 January 2025 + two days. Evidence of late receipt needs to be filed 
with the response.

question_text: 11. Which functionalities or services can be accessed directly from MyEPO Portfolio?

answer_choices.a: A shared area with examiners, European Patent Register, filing via the EPO’s  online filing software eOLF
answer_choices.b: Mailbox, a shared area with examiners, replying to a communication under  Article 94(3) EPC
answer_choices.c: Mailbox, patent search via publication server, a shared area with examiners
answer_choices.d: Filing via the EPO’s Online Filing 2.0, patent search via publication server,  Mailbox

legal_basis.text: https://www.epo.org/en/applying/myepo-services/interact

A. Incorrect: it is neither possible to access the European Patent Register nor to 
file using the EPO’s legacy Online Filing software (eOLF) via MyEPO Portfolio 
B. Correct 
C. Incorrect: it is not possible to access the European Publication Server via 
MyEPO Portfolio 
D. Incorrect: it is neither possible to access the European Publication Server nor 
to file using the EPO’s Online Filing 2.0 via MyEPO Portfolio

question_text: 12. In which of the following situations does the EPO recommend using the EPO  Contingency Upload Service?

answer_choices.a: When you submit documents after business hours
answer_choices.b: When the EPO filing systems are functioning correctly, but you encounter a  technical issue at your end
answer_choices.c: When there is a system outage at the EPO that prevents document submission  via the standard filing systems
answer_choices.d: When the EPO is closed due to an official holiday

legal_basis.text: OJ EPO 2023, A50, point 20; Contingency Upload Service | epo.org

question_text: 13. Applicant Korhonen is a Finnish national resident in Finland. He filed a European  patent application in Finnish and provided an English translation in time. In response  to the extended European search report (EESR), Korhonen wishes to file amended  claims together with a request for examination.     Which of the following statements is correct?

answer_choices.a: Korhonen must file the amended claims in Finnish and must then  provide  a  translation into English, in time
answer_choices.b: Korhonen is allowed to file the amended claims in Finnish if he then provides a  translation into any official language of the EPO, in time
answer_choices.c: Korhonen is allowed to file the amended claims in Finnish if he then provides a  translation into English, in time
answer_choices.d: Korhonen is not allowed to file the amended claims in Finnish

legal_basis.text: Guidelines for Examination in the EPO, A-VII, 3.2; Rule 3(2) EPC

Since the response with the amendments has to be filed within a time limit, the 
Finnish applicant is entitled to file the amended claims in Finnish. 
A translation of a document filed in an admissible non-EPO language into an official 
language of the EPO must be filed within a non-extendable period of one month 
(Rule 6(2) EPC). This means that a translation of the amended claims must be filed 
in the language of proceedings, English in this case (Rule 3(2) EPC).

question_text: 14. Applicants may request processing of their international application under PCT  Direct by filing a letter ("PCT Direct letter") containing informal comments, aimed at  overcoming objections raised in the search opinion established by the EPO for the  priority application.     Which of the following statements is NOT correct?

answer_choices.a: PCT Direct is available if the priority application is a Belgian application filed in  French, which has been searched and the international application is filed in French,  using ePCT-Filing
answer_choices.b: PCT Direct is available if the priority application is an EP application filed in  French, which has been searched and the international application is filed in English,  using Online Filing 2.0
answer_choices.c: PCT Direct is available if the priority application is an international application  filed with the EPO in English, which has been searched by the EPO and the subsequent  international application is filed in English, using Online Filing 2.0
answer_choices.d: PCT Direct is available on condition that amended claims are filed with the PCT  Direct letter, in a single PDF document

legal_basis.text: PCT-EPO Guidelines, B-IV, 1.2.
Comments are required but not amendments.

question_text: 15. Mr Linguist filed a European patent application in Dutch and used English as  language of the proceedings. When requesting unitary effect on 10 October 2024,  Mr Linguist must provide a translation of the specification.     Mr Linguist would like to obtain immediate registration of the unitary effect. Which of  the following statements is correct?

answer_choices.a: Mr Linguist must provide a translation of the specification into Dutch
answer_choices.b: Mr Linguist must provide a translation of the specification into an official  language of any of the 18 states to which the unitary effect extends
answer_choices.c: Mr Linguist must provide a translation of the specification into an official  language of any of the 24 states that have signed the UPCA
answer_choices.d: Mr Linguist may provide a translation of the specification into Spanish

legal_basis.text:
Article 6(1) Regulation (EU) No 1260/2012; Rule 6(2)(d) UPR; Unitary Patent Guide, 
para. 65

The translation may be in any of the 24 official languages of the EU, except English, 
irrespective of the language in which the application was filed or the geographical 
extent of the unitary effect.
